overview_description.description: Duffel provides an online platform that allows users to search, book, and manage flights from multiple airlines. It helps businesses of every size to provide flight booking experiences for their customers. The platform allows users to search for flights with real-time pricing and availability, increase revenue with ancillaries like baggage and lounge access, manage customer refunds and cancellations, and integrate with its API or ready-to-go agent booking tool.

product.description: An API-based hotel booking product providing access to more than 1 million properties, with hotel search, booking content, loyalty benefits, and commission opportunities.
